_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in the Disbelief band with elevated VIX/gold strength versus weak BTC momentum and funding, so the honest base-rate call in this coil is to hold the current rung until a clear breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst firmly HOLD/Disbelief; narrative implies continued pressure but does not contradict the coil/HOLD stance
next_move.confirmed_if: VIX stays elevated, gold holds relative strength, and BTC funding/momentum remain soft with institutional caution in options skew
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC momentum and funding turn sharply positive while fear/greed rises and VIX compresses, breaking the coil upward
